approaches.name: Digitized construction permitting system for development control
approaches.description: Project prepares development control tools including digitization of the manual construction permitting process.
approaches.why_innovative: New process: digital permitting replaces manual multi-office approvals - cue: 'digitization of permitting systems' | category Operational; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: (c) prepare development control tools, including digitization of permitting systems; and (d) deliver targeted training to civil servants and appointed officials at the central and local government level with the possible inclusion of community-level organizations, which will ensure that female staff of the municipalities will benefit.

extra_evidence.text: Ultimately, the strengthening of urban development control systems and practices, using climate risk maps to inform no- build zones, paired with a public awareness campaign on climate risks also to be supported under the program, is anticipated to contribute to a reduction of citizens settling in high climate and flood-risk zones or ecologically sensitive areas, thereby reducing climate risk in the medium to long term.

category.rationale: Operational: re-engineers permitting delivery, not a new technology per se

adoption.rationale: Digital core: digitized permitting system | Innovative: replaces manual multi-agency permits | Category: re-engineered delivery process

approaches.name: drone aerial surveys producing terrain models for drainage design
approaches.description: Project uses drone surveys and orthophotos to build topographic maps and drainage models.
approaches.why_innovative: New service: drone survey terrain models feed drainage feasibility - cue: 'drone survey' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: Detailed aerial surveys of the Project area have already been conducted using drone survey techniques and resulted in high-resolution terrain models and orthophotos of the Greater Monrovia area.

extra_evidence.text: In Component 1, this information will enable the creation of detailed topographic maps and will feed into detailed models to be developed during the feasibility study phase to understand drainage systems.

category.rationale: Technological: drone remote sensing is the core data mechanism

adoption.rationale: Digital core: drone orthophotos and terrain models | Innovative: replaces ground survey for drainage design | Category: remote sensing
